From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-05T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: initial findings — leader election instability after orchestrator upgrade

Ben / Hannah / Soojin —

Quick internal status: we observed repeated leader-election timeouts on the control-plane orchestrator immediately after the 07:45 maintenance image rollout. Symptoms: agents in the private VPC lost leases, KV cache invalidated intermittently, and several API nodes stopped accepting new streaming connections for short windows (~10–30s).

Preliminary root cause (working hypothesis): a regression in the leader-election backoff implemented in the new orchestrator image (v2.14.0+opt) that causes aggressive retries and transient split-brain during scale-up of control-plane pods. The failed leases align with the maintenance rollout timeframe.

Mitigations attempted so far:
- Forced leader re-election on the cluster — temporarily restored connectivity for some nodes (not all).
- Increased lease TTL on the cluster controller to 20s to reduce flapping risk.

Recommendation: schedule a rollback of the orchestrator image on the affected private control-plane nodes to v2.13.7 (the previous stable) with a staged rollout and a pre-check for agent lease stability. That should restore normal leader election behavior.

I'll prepare logs and a sanitized support archive for Silverline. Attaching support-log-archive.tar.gz with timestamped controller traces.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
(attachment: support-log-archive.tar.gz)

Date: 2027-06-05T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Update & proposed rollback window (private VPC)

Jordan —

Thanks again for the quick signal and the logs. High-level update for Silverline: our SRE team traced the intermittent failures to leader-election instability in the control-plane that coincided with our orchestrator image rollout at 07:45 PT. The root-cause appears to be a regression in the leader-election backoff logic in the new image.

Proposed immediate action (we recommend this):
- Roll back orchestrator nodes in your private control-plane from v2.14.0+opt to v2.13.7.
- Staged rollout starting 2027-06-05 23:00 PT (low-traffic window), anticipated impact: a single 10–15 minute window of controller restarts; we will coordinate with you live and run pre/post checks.
- If you prefer, we can instead fail traffic to hosted endpoints — but that requires your approval and will route traffic outside your VPC for the short window.

We will also offer a goodwill credit against June usage given the impact. We'll provide a postmortem within 48 hours.

Please reply with APPROVE to authorize the rollback at 23:00 PT or indicate if you'd prefer the hosted failover option. Attached is our proposed mitigation plan with rollback steps and validation checks (proposed-mitigation-plan.pdf).

Thanks —
Ben
(attachment: proposed-mitigation-plan.pdf)
